selected_records.title: The AI policy window is open. We need to act.

article.body:
OpenAI's AI Policy Call Does Not Establish Approved Policy Change

OpenAI's statement, "The AI policy window is open. We need to act," indicates a call for action on AI policy. The provided record does not establish a specific approved rule or government action, nor does it identify an organisation required to change its practice. It also lacks evidence of a resulting capability or implementation, as it is an appeal, not a policy change.

The Department of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Policy (DAIDP) is the affected organisation, as they are the body responsible for implementing AI policies. The call for action does not currently require any specific changes from DAIDP or any other organisation. The policy remains proposed, not approved or in effect.
